findings.title: T planting target chooses sampled minimum instead of native zone/random overlapping area
findings.evidence: Compatibility Idle calls buildManagedObjectiveTarget only after deadline/zone admission. Builder computes five extent samples, chooses minimum reachable weighted Safest candidate and target point. Native chooses GetClosestZone(PathCost) and then a random overlapping NAV area; position inside that overlap is a deterministic midpoint. Existing bombSitePoint helper matches midpoint semantics but is not used by this planting builder. Thus target choice and RNG consumption still differ after resolved admission/order fixes.
findings.tests: round_objectives_tests.cpp:179 and :223 exercise generic bounded legacy helper; they do not establish native production zone/area choice. Need adversarial multi-area/multi-zone production fixture and matched native target/RNG trace.
findings.backlog_mapping: 23 Idle/MoveTo,24; five-group3 and5 need explicit expansion
findings.title_ja: T設置先のzone選択・重複area抽選

findings.title: CT bomb-search nearest-site distance uses weighted Fastest cost
findings.evidence: Astra stores Fastest corridor.cost as site.travel, then compares it to 2000 and picks minimum. Native ShortestPathCost selects a route with +20*distance CROUCH and +5*distance JUMP penalties (and ladder length), then NavAreaTravelDistance returns geometric center distances along the selected route. Astra Fastest instead charges +1*distance JUMP, rejects consecutive JUMP, may apply health/crowding context, and exposes weighted accumulated cost here. Selection cost and returned distance therefore both differ; this can reorder sites and change far-away random fallback.
findings.tests: Need two bombsites whose geometric and weighted order differ and exact 2000 boundary, comparing actual production selected target/RNG.
findings.backlog_mapping: 11A/11B implemented reporting remains;23/24 selection parity open
findings.title_ja: CT探索siteの距離・経路コストの区別

findings.title: Hunt timeout does not clear cached rogue status
findings.evidence: Native >30s Hunt explicitly SetRogue(false) before Idle. Core only transitions Idle. TeamworkPolicy rogue_ changes on RNG refresh/reset; timeout caller neither resets nor clears it. A still-running rogue timer can therefore retain true into next Idle scenario decision.
findings.tests: compat_state_machine_tests.cpp:385 verifies only state timeout, not TeamworkPolicy value. teamwork_policy_tests.cpp:149 verifies resetValues but timeout never calls it. Need production timer-survives-timeout test without resetting timer/RNG.
findings.title_ja: Hunt30秒退出時のrogue解除

findings.title: Offensive Idle sniper decisions remain absent
findings.evidence: Native noncarrier T bomb, non-VIP CT VIP, unescorted CT hostage, and default/deathmatch Idle each perform friends+sniper+10% camp draw and Hide for 10..30 seconds within2000 before subsequent action. Traced Astra scenario callers and radio selectors only implement defense sniper selection for CT bomb/T hostage. T Fetch is selected before such offensive draw.
findings.tests: No assigned scenario test asserts offensive sniper RNG/preemption. Need cases for all four branches including loose C4 priority.
findings.title_ja: 攻撃側Idleの狙撃待機抽選

findings.title: CT hostage collecting/rescuing is an inferred subset of native task policy
findings.evidence: Astra acquires nearest visible living hostage, uses bound UseEntity target, infers escort from motion with competitor veto and 2/3-second receipt windows, retries max3 then Hunt. Production does not populate authoritative escortKnown/count. Native CT radar knows free hostages, authoritative escort ownership/count, compares rescue-zone versus next-hostage route travel, may fetch more, changes route/disposition, tracks loss and increments escort count on use. Retained Help task explicitly comments follow leader unavailable. This includes observation and decision differences, not just a missing receipt.
findings.tests: scenario_behavior_tests.cpp:152-246 positively tests inference/retries; these establish current subset, not native parity. Need authoritative public bridge assessment plus multi-hostage competing-CT collect/rescue/loss replay and live rescue.
findings.title_ja: CT人質収集/救助・護送数・移動比較

findings.title: T hostage opportunistic guard transitions are incomplete
findings.evidence: T Idle defense implementation exists. Its production invocation is Idle-only; planner hostageDecision returns empty for T. Native Hunt can head off rescue when all are following or guard a newly seen free hostage after safe time; Hide rescue-zone guarding can switch to visible free hostage. Current authoritative free/follow state absent, and assigned scenario update has no equivalent opportunistic producer. Event-driven HostageUsed reactions are a separate implemented path.
findings.tests: Existing T report/defense tests do not prove spontaneous Hunt/Hide visible-free-hostage transition. Need authority-qualified native event+visibility fixtures and runtime acceptance.
findings.title_ja: TのHunt/Hide中の人質警備変更

findings.title: T Hide defuser threat reaction is missing
findings.evidence: Native T in Hide checks any defuser within2000; visible planted bomb causes Attack(defuser), otherwise MoveTo(defuser position,FASTEST) and InhibitLookAround10. Astra scenario data only queries nativeDefuserSlot for CT; bombDecision T yields Guard. Parent crosschecked other producer domain: defuser helpers only CT guard/report, no T reaction.
findings.tests: Need T guarding near/far defuser, bomb visible/occluded, death/cancel/reuse and public identity tests; live defuse interception not established.
findings.backlog_mapping: 23 Hide,25; not explicitly enumerated in five groups
findings.title_ja: TのHide中の解除者迎撃

findings.title: VIP and Escape state policies are simplified nearest-target projections
findings.evidence: Astra picks nearest zone center geometrically and non-VIP actors Follow/Guard observed VIP. Native VIP and escaping T choose random zone before20s, closest route-cost zone later, then random overlapping area. Defending T VIP/CT escape have sniper/rogue/rush/morale zone-defense branches. Direct VIP Follow-me radio transport being implemented does not establish these tactical policies.
findings.tests: scenario_behavior_tests.cpp:296 only asserts one known VIP escape action; add multiple zones,20s boundary, defenders, no VIP/zone and RNG order; live as_/es_ acceptance absent.
findings.title_ja: VIP/Escapeの20秒境界・区域/戦術選択

findings.title: Scenario identity and legacy hostage rescue-zone discovery differ
findings.evidence: Astra scenario behavior branches from cs_/as_/es_/de_ map prefix. Native scans entity classes and defaults deathmatch. Native hostage maps with zero rescue zones use info_player_start (explicit cs_assault comment); Astra scenario acquisition only recognizes func_/info_hostage_rescue. Radio supplemental discovery must be checked separately before global absence claim; primary CT scenario target definitely omits this fallback. Supplemental radio.cpp743-791 implements info_player_start fallback for T defense. Missing primary CT rescue target fallback is therefore a specific asymmetry, not global absence.
findings.tests: Need nonstandard map prefix with bomb/hostage/VIP entities, mixed class ordering, no objective prefix match, and legacy info_player_start rescue scenario.
findings.backlog_mapping: 23 scenario/manager; cs_assault group3 covers ladder only and omits rescue fallback
findings.title_ja: entityによるscenario判別とCT旧救出地点fallback

findings.title: Bomb guarding selection/lifetime still differs from native Hide
findings.evidence: BombGuardPlanner chooses nearby flags/capped256 candidates, validates path, duration and retains/reselects via planner cache; failed selection holds self. Native T Idle first tries random hiding spot over planted zone's Place, then Hide nearby; native Hide has ambush draw/hold delay, occupancy retry/Hide-reentry semantics, arrival setup and path-failure replacement/Idle policy. CT radio-driven hideNearArea is more complete and must not be conflated with this T planted-bomb guard producer.
findings.tests: scenario_behavior_tests.cpp:551+ tests current BombGuardPlanner selection/cache/no-cover and performance bounds; no native same-condition Place-vs-radius/occupancy/failure/lifetime replay. Live guarding remains unverified.
findings.title_ja: T爆弾警備の隠れ場所選定・寿命

findings.title: Buy shield is implemented; career and exact lifecycle/observations remain bounded
findings.evidence: Shield allow CVar/gamestate/readback and native table/retry branches are present. Public BuyContext career defaultsfalse and production does not set it, while native career excludes kit purchase. Buy RNG initialization happens controller first update, not a literal OnEnter callback. Exact private linked-slot/active/default-pistol and post-buy freeze equip/reload equivalence are not established by these files; do not label shield purchase missing.
findings.tests: Assigned tests omit buy-specific fixture; parent domain may supply existing economy/live evidence. Need career kit exclusion and buy entry/reset RNG timing/current public inventory equivalence cases.
findings.title_ja: BuyのCareer・状態進入/装備観測の厳密性

findings.title: Auto-follow human allowance remains explicitly inferred
findings.evidence: TeamworkPolicy explicitly approximates private human allowance via accepted radio; candidate acquisition/travel/follower-count has public constraints. Follow motion itself is substantially implemented and its path/order fixes should remain closed. Authority-equivalence for human follow allowance is not proved. Also native update.cpp707 comments out the nonnegative travel check, so unreachable -1 may pass the <300 threshold; Astra candidateReachable rejects a failed corridor. This conservative difference is separate from the human allowance proxy.
findings.tests: teamwork_policy_tests.cpp:299 tests inferred60s public radio policy; need native player allowance comparison and multi-human eligibility replay.
findings.title_ja: 人間leaderのauto-follow許可の観測

findings.title: Resolved Plant/Idle changes retain bounded live gaps
findings.evidence: Current source implements early Idle/Follow plant/Hunt yield; MoveTo waits evaluated nonprogressing path and refreshes ownership/zone; Plant input precedes loss/timeout/EquipBest exit. Existing documented isolated HLDS/CDB accepts arrival/zone exit/actual drop/plant. Explicit C4 inventory-bit fixture sync, natural pickup, initial unequipped-C4 enemy interaction, real waterlevel3 choice, standard GameDLL and custom multiple-slot-first authority remain open. These are acceptance/authority limits, not missing normal Plant state code.
findings.tests: compat_state_machine_tests.cpp:406,:751 cover order and boundaries. See STATUS.md:17,:51,:153-175 and csbot-idle-buy-look-supply-20261122/evidence-final-v2/acceptance.json. Historical tests were not rerun in this audit.

findings.title: NAV learning/analysis/writing is intentionally outside active milestone
findings.evidence: Native learns nodes, analyzes hiding/approach/encounter/sniper spots and saves NAV. Project backlog expressly excludes NAV authoring/learning from milestone. This is an excluded feature difference, not an active repair falsely declared complete.
findings.tests: No live NAV authoring acceptance sought; do not add to current work scope without user decision.
findings.title_ja: NAV学習/解析/編集/保存（現対戦milestone外）

findings.title: Hide route failure and newly occupied spot do not use native replacement policy
findings.evidence: Radio-driven defense/retreat/Follow-cover selects occupancy/path on entry. Primary scenario update checks expiry, objective, damage and feet arrival, but no en-route closest-player occupancy replacement. finishNavigation only consumes MoveTo/InvestigateNoise/FetchBomb, leaving Hide path terminal results without native FindNearbyHidingSpot/recompute/Idle branch. Native checks newly occupied spot while approaching and replaces on nonprogressing path, falls back to current location when no hiding spot, and Idle if replacement ComputePath fails. BombGuardPlanner does have its own visible occupancy reselection, so this finding specifically targets normal holdPosition-owned Hide paths and their terminal handling.
findings.tests: Need production Hold/Guard/retreat Hide fixture where another visible player occupies spot after admission, plus path failure/replacement unavailable/current-position fallback/failed replacement; existing scenario guard tests cover BombGuardPlanner only.
findings.backlog_mapping: 23 Hide and group3 failure,24/25; distinct from resolved Follow-cover precompute/order
findings.title_ja: 通常Hideの占有・経路失敗時の場所再選択

findings.title: Look owners still have separate momentum and guard uses fixed-speed full-update turns
findings.evidence: Guard clamps 240deg/sec at full decisions; Combat uses its own aimSpring_; Noise clears its own spring on a new point and command applyCombatUpkeep resets navigation spring. Native one m_lookYawVel/m_lookPitchVel spans all goals, integrated once per Upkeep. Combat buildAim also calls trackAim with default attacking=true even for non-Attack aiming.
findings.tests: bomb_guard_look_tests.cpp:37;noise_look_tests.cpp:62;combat_target_log_tests.cpp:928 tests owner replacement but not momentum equality.
findings.title_ja: 全look ownerの角速度共有・Guardの定速旋回

findings.evidence: C02-1 public active weapon identity, no-target pin hold, recognized copied target, strict >3/alignment release, independent look/weapon-change lifecycle and explicit Clear receipt implemented. findings.historical_title: Production grenade throw initiation is unreachable; native throw lifecycle not implemented
findings.historical_evidence: combatVisible excludes Grenade, targetVisible copies combatVisible, only requestGrenade producer is inside isGrenade&&targetVisible branch. Full src/include producer search found no alternate throw producer. Native recognizes threat→ThrowGrenade and safe-end path-corner toss; it holds attack while equipped and releases after alignment/strict countdown. findings.historical_tests: weapon_actions_tests.cpp:326-346 and grenade_trajectory_tests.cpp exercise core only; combat_target_log_tests.cpp:1531 covers no Attack with grenade, not positive actual throw.

findings.title: General weapon lifecycle rearming and early-safe grenade/knife selection are not wired
findings.evidence: equipBestWeapon has correct submerged candidate check, but all production callers are objective/scenario special cases. No general MUST_EQUIP on submerged forbidden active weapon; no unsafe empty/knife rearm; no safe5s pistol→usable primary; no native early-safe EquipGrenade/knife choice (no SelectGrenade action). These are missing triggers, distinct from direct real-submersion acceptance of already implemented selection.
findings.tests: weapon_equipment_tests.cpp:268-336 proves helper/timer/water matrix; weapon_switch_runtime_tests.cpp:184 proves primary-empty→pistol only.
findings.title_ja: 通常Updateの装備再選択・安全時間中の装備

findings.title: Silencer policy exists only as core capability with no production request
findings.evidence: All src/include producer search finds no requestSilencer assignment. Runtime reads silencer state but never sets desired profile/skill preference, quiet-enemy time or request. Native SilencerCheck runs after ReloadCheck, suppresses during attack/defuse/reload, and skill>.7 forces preference with readiness guard. findings.tests: weapon_actions_tests.cpp:315-325 tests synthetic mode input only.
findings.title_ja: SilencerCheck要求の実行時接続

findings.title: Shotgun long-range pistol switch is missing
findings.evidence: Native shotgun distance>1000 calls EquipPistol independently of fire alignment. Astra only distance-switches sniper<310 and primary empty/footsteps; no shotgun range-switch producer exists.
findings.tests: weapon_actions_tests.cpp sniper switching coverage; no positive shotgun long-range production case found.
findings.title_ja: 遠距離ショットガンから拳銃への切替

findings.title: Sniper scope lifecycle is incomplete and resumeZoom input has no producer
findings.evidence: resumeZoom exists only input/read, never assigned in production; no stationary pre-scope via weapon-sight range or moving-view unzoom; no global scope exit when not attacking/not at hiding spot. Core scope requests are gated by requestFire/aim-aligned unlike native Attack scope handling before fire tolerance. findings.title_ja: 狙撃銃のscope解除/事前zoom/resumeZoom

findings.title: Combat dodge/range behavior stops on lost LOS and resets on reacquisition
findings.evidence: Astra prepareMovement requires combatVisible; otherwise stopMovement. Native dodge persists before chase even without visible enemy; range adjustment applies skill<.66 OR !visible. Astra input lacks visible flag and only checks skill<.66. Reacquisition enters movement anew/firstDodge even without new Attack entry.
findings.tests: combat_policy_tests.cpp:233 tests visible range correction, no LOS-loss persistent dodge case.
findings.title_ja: 敵を見失った後の回避・距離調整

findings.title: Combat Upkeep re-traces visibility and adds decision-time spring/offset steps
findings.evidence: Native Upkeep consumes preceding full-update visibility/parts, updates offset/spring once, then full Update changes decisions. Astra upkeepCombat makes fresh collectVisibility and friendly line trace every command; decideCombatAction also calls decide→buildAim→offset+spring on full updates. This can differ on mid-full occlusion and duplicate aim smoothing/extra trace cost. This is verified cadence difference; not asserted cause of observed stutter/FPS without live comparison.
findings.tests: combat_target_log_tests.cpp existing actual aim/cached-light coverage; add independent expected native per-upkeep trajectory and trace-count case.
findings.title_ja: Combat軽更新/全更新の視認・照準積分順

findings.title: Friendly-fire and enemy shield firing gates remain different
findings.evidence: Astra always suppresses same-team obstruction outside FFA, using segment eye→target rather than native recoil+view10k ray only when friendly-fire enabled. Candidate carries delayed reload but no delayed protected-by-shield field, and FireWeaponAtEnemy shield-facing fire suppression has no equivalent in WeaponActionInput. Native shield threat ordering also differs. Existing retaliation FFA support does not establish generic FFA search parity.
findings.tests: combat_target_log_tests.cpp:2107 proves obstruction behavior; shield fixture1318 verifies OWN shield control, not enemy shield suppression.
findings.title_ja: friendly-fire・敵の盾を含む発砲/脅威判定

findings.title: Breakable grenade equipment bypasses shared EquipBestWeapon state
findings.evidence: Obstacle uses independent obstacleNextEquipAt, ad-hoc ammo test (unknown is usable), slot1/slot2 and no submerged/weapon flag check; native calls same EquipBestWeapon/DoEquip clock used elsewhere. A prior ordinary equip within5s may still allow obstacle switch; obstacle selection does not update global equipment timer. Existing touch material/path logic is implemented and should not be reopened wholesale.
findings.tests: obstacle_interaction_runtime_tests.cpp:151-212 isolated throttle/ammo fallback positive, no shared-clock interleave/submersion case.
findings.title_ja: 破壊物対応の装備時計を共通EquipBestへ接続

findings.title: Reload without visible enemy does not clear movement after state update
findings.evidence: Native end-of-Update clears movement while reloading and enemy not visible (after state behavior). Astra reload action preserves movement, WeaponActionPlanner reloading return does not stopMovement, and command runtime has no general reload/no-visible stop. Cover selection is implemented separately; this missing final phase can move bot while native stops.
findings.tests: weapon equipment/reload-cover tests cover reload request and cover state, not final no-LOS command stop.
findings.title_ja: 敵非可視で再装填中の最終移動停止

findings.title: Ground discontinuity jumps and ground probes remain a bounded alternate algorithm
findings.evidence: Compatibility uses configured step16, prior accepted route direction/freshness, near30 upward-only bounded jump and far-drop/gap veto. Native probes current requested direction and attempts far80 down, near30 up/down, gap10 MUST_JUMP down. Astra reads all floor probes before the decision rather than stopping after successful jump. Concrete divergence, not merely unknown collision acceptance.

findings.title: Native lateral feeler steering is not represented in the active ground command pipeline
findings.evidence: Reviewed actual adapter→roam→locomotion ground path: target normalizes directly to follower point; public ground work is downward floor probes. Native aligns left/right ankle feelers to floor normal, uses precise/jump/near-end gates and adjusts goal by150/300 lateral units if exactly one side blocks. No side-feeler input or adjustment exists in the reviewed production pipeline (global include/src/tests searches confirm). This positive native operation/current-pipeline comparison does not assert a live map symptom.
findings.backlog_mapping: 23/group3 and non-C4/tight-map route work; 25 live collision acceptance

findings.title: Physical drop gate forbids survivable painful drops accepted by native path cost
findings.evidence: Runtime computes zero-damage envelope from500u/s and requires descents to fit it; Drop permits landingDamage0 only. Native PathCost accepts fall damage if health exceeds damage+10, weighting survivable pain by route/aggression; direct UpdatePathMovement has no zero-damage landing gate. Analytical case: sv_gravity800/entityGravity1/from rest yields Astra maximum156.25; a200-unit drop estimates17.56 native damage and remains allowed at100HP. This is source arithmetic, not an executed test/live claim.
findings.backlog_mapping: 23/group3 physical traversal/safety-policy difference; 24/25 matching-condition replay and physical acceptance

findings.title: Hostage escort crouch penalty exists in Core but production cost context leaves count zero
findings.evidence: Core multiplies crouch penalty by3 when hostageEscortCount nonzero. Production managedPathCostContext returns initialized context after supplying health, aggression, attack and per-area danger/crowd, never the escort count. Native directly uses GetHostageEscortCount. Current public hostage use receipts do not establish current followers/counts; do not substitute a guessed counter.

findings.title: Arbitrary non-player/custom public sounds still become Compatibility investigation noise
findings.evidence: Outside five excluded hostage calls and connected native flash/step/weapon suppression, EmitSound categorizes arbitrary samples as Other/WeaponFire with attenuation range and Medium priority. Non-player source remains invalid and bypasses teammate/source-validity filtering. Native default REGAMEDLL_FIXES rejects nonplayers in generic OnEvent, then checks enemy and explicit event audibility whitelist. Existing test positively requires custom hostage sample and help sample from nonhostage to be audible, demonstrating broader unsupported sound intake rather than only absent implementation.

findings.title: Standard GameDLL mapped shots retain deferred listener selection/localization
findings.evidence: Mapped PlaybackEvent calls recordSound(fallbackWeapon=true,authoritative=false). Receipt localization condition accepts only Footstep or authoritative source, so these shots use listener distance/team/source validation and RNG during next collectManagedPerception. Native OnEvent evaluates listener distance and localization immediately; listener motion/range crossing and RNG interleaving can differ. Connected native-provider shots/footsteps already take receipt-time path and should not be reopened wholesale.

findings.title: A* decrease-to-equal open-node order differs from native cost-sorted list
findings.evidence: Native decreased open-node cost bubbles past strictly greater predecessors and stops behind preexisting equal-cost predecessor. Astra mutates record cost in place and strict-min scans unchanged open-vector/discovery order. Earlier-discovered A currently20, later B10, improve A→10: native B precedes A; Astra can choose A first. Existing equal initial discovery fixture is insufficient to prove decrease-to-equal ordering. No specific map regression claimed.
